identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Of FOLFIRI Chemotherapy With Or Without Sunitinib In Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomised, Double-Blind, Phase 3 Study Of Sunitinib In Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Patients Receiving Irinotecan, 5-Fluorouracil And Leucovorin (FOLFIRI) As First Line Treatment

interventions.name: 5 fluorouracil
interventions.description: 400mg/m2 bolus injection day 1 followed by 2400mg/m2 continuous infusion for 46 hours every 14 days

interventions.name: sunitinib
interventions.description: 37.5mg of blinded therapy every day for 28 days followed by 14 days of blinded therapy free period

interventions.name: 5 fluorouracil
interventions.description: 400mg/m2 bolus injection day 1 followed by 2400mg/m2 continuous infusion for 46 hours every 14 days

interventions.name: placebo
